prompt_text:
Task: Batch Speech-to-Text

Write code that submits an audio file for batch transcription using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Alibaba Model Studio ASR:
  Service: Paraformer / Model Studio ASR
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: Recognition.call, Paraformer
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/speech-recognition

Option 2 — AssemblyAI:
  Service: AssemblyAI Transcripts API
  SDK: assemblyai
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: transcripts.submit, transcripts.get
  Setup hints: ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/transcripts/submit

Option 3 — Azure AI Speech:
  Service: Azure AI Speech
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechRecognizer, recognize_once_async
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/speech-to-text

Option 4 — Amazon Transcribe:
  Service: Amazon Transcribe
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_transcription_job, get_transcription_job
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/what-is.html

Option 5 — Watson Speech to Text:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text

Option 6 — Cloud Speech-to-Text:
  Service: Cloud Speech-to-Text
  SDK: google-cloud-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: long_running_recognize, recognize
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import os
import time
from typing import Optional

import assemblyai as aai


def batch_transcribe_audio(
    audio_path_or_url: str,
    timeout_seconds: int = 3600,
    poll_interval_seconds: int = 10,
) -> str:
    api_key = os.getenv("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        raise EnvironmentError("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY is not set")

    aai.settings.api_key = api_key

    transcript = aai.Transcript()
    transcript = aai.Transcriber().transcribe(audio_path_or_url)

    start = time.time()
    while transcript.status not in {"completed", "error"}:
        if time.time() - start > timeout_seconds:
            raise TimeoutError("Timed out waiting for batch transcription to complete")
        time.sleep(poll_interval_seconds)
        transcript = aai.Transcript.get(transcript.id)

    if transcript.status == "error":
        raise RuntimeError(f"Transcription failed: {transcript.error}")

    return transcript.text or ""


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys

    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
        raise SystemExit("Usage: python script.py <audio_path_or_url>")

    print(batch_transcribe_audio(sys.argv[1]))
